problems: University of the Sciences no longer exists as an independent institution: the OpenAlex homepage http://www.usciences.edu/ redirects to https://www.sju.edu/ (Saint Joseph's University), and SJU's history page records the 2022 merger.

The successor (Saint Joseph's University) lists only two research PhDs on its doctoral-programs page (https://www.sju.edu/degree-programs?field_degree_certificates_target_id[4111]=4111): 'Pharmaceutics PhD' and 'Pharmacology and Toxicology PhD' - neither is a relevant program type and no relevant authors were associated with them, so no programs recorded.

All 4 relevant authors look like University of Pennsylvania faculty mis-attributed by OpenAlex (Penn/USciences/Philadelphia University name confusion); recommend mapping them via University of Pennsylvania instead. Not verified on Penn pages here.
